BadField.description: `bad-field`: a field is out of range, of the other connection type, or names nothing listed; the error names it

Failed.description: `failed`: the service failed; the error is the failure as a sentence

Forbidden.description: `forbidden`: the token is right but the caller may not do this: a caller's token on a route but a run or a file transfer, the service's own token on either of those two, or a run or a file transfer the node does not let the caller make; the error names why

bearer.description: The service's token, from the caller's own configuration; on a run and on a file transfer, the caller's own token.

info.description: The node service: the machines reachable from here and what is known of them. Nodes and hubs, how to reach a node, checking whether each answers, and each machine's hardware readings. A machine carries its readings, tracking and CPU limit; whether a launch may start on it is the caller's own policy, read from these fields. Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys, and times are integers of epoch milliseconds. Every route needs the service's bearer token, but a run and a file transfer, which need a caller's own token. Every failure and refusal is a non-2xx status with a body of `code` and `error`. A page is `items` and `more`. Any other method and path is answered 404 `no-route`.
